description: CrlChecker stores raw DER bytes and calls CertificateList::from_der on every invocation of check_revocation. When validating a chain of N certs against the same CRL, the CRL is parsed N times. The results are identical each time so correctness is not affected, but the repeated parse is unnecessary work and is O(N) in chain length. Should cache the parsed CertificateList.
title: CrlChecker re-parses DER on every check_revocation call
